done_when: For new and existing client repos, the shipped guide says a fast test in pull request CI must include the tests that import changed source files, split across the test groups, that a local fast test may stay smaller, that the full suite stays nightly, and it warns against a changed-files-only script.
why: A repo's own fast test ran only the changed test files plus a few fixed files in pull request CI, so unchanged tests that import a changed source file were skipped, failed on the main branch, and blocked every other close.
